import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for the event details. INVITATION_FORMAT = """

{event_title}

{event_description}

Date: {event_date}

{additional_notes}
""" def generate_event_invite(title: str, description: str, date: str, notes: str) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of an event invitation. Parameters ---------- title : str The title or name of the event. description : str A comprehensive description of the event (may include multiple paragraphs and formatting). date : str The scheduled date of the event. notes : str Any supplementary information or instructions provided by the event organizer. Returns ------- str A string containing sanitized HTML for secure display of the event invitation. Raises ------ TypeError If any argument is not a string. """ # Validate input types if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (title, description, date, notes)): raise TypeError("All arguments must be strings") # Escape all user-provided content to neutralize HTML injection escaped_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) escaped_description = html.escape(description, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') escaped_date = html.escape(date, quote=True) escaped_notes = html.escape(notes, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') # Render the template with sanitized values return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=escaped_title, event_description=escaped_description, event_date=escaped_date, additional_notes=escaped_notes )
